newsitem.title: USA: Finish Line Q2 same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Finish Line Q2 same-store sales rise.

text.p: Finish Line Inc said Thursday its same-store sales for the second quarter ended August 31 rose 17 percent from the comparable period last year.
Total sales for the quarter increased 41 percent, to $91 million from $64.6 million a year earlier.
Comparable net footwear sales were up 15 percent in the quarter. Comparable store activewear/accessories net sales increased 21 percent.

For the six months ended August 31, net sales were $162.8 million, a 39 percent increase over $116.8 million in the first half of last year. On a year-to-date basis, comparable store net sales increased 15 percent.
Alan Cohen, chairman, said sales gains reflected added staff and system upgrades.
Merchandise inventories as of August 31, on a per square foot basis, have been reduced by seven to eight percent compared with a year ago.
During the second quarter, two new larger stores -- in Buffalo, N.Y., and Denver, Colo. -- had strong openings, the company said.

After completion of the second quarter, 17 of the planned 35 new stores for the fiscal year had been opened, and the company said it was on plan to meet its goal of increasing store square footage by 25 percent this year.
Finish Line, a specialty retailer of men's, women's and children's athletic and leisure footwear, activewear and accessories, operates 235 stores.
